prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1357; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's all right. I'm happy to answer everything else.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what happened?

A: I was heading down the main road in Sugar Land, in the right lane, going maybe twenty-five miles an hour because of the traffic. The other car came over into my lane and we hit nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me.

Q: Did you have time to brake or swerve before impact?

A: I hit the brakes, but there wasn't much room. I think the other driver was looking down at something, or maybe was trying to pass a slow truck. I didn't see it coming until it was right there.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags didn't deploy, but the belt pulled tight across my chest.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right away?

A: Not immediately. I felt okay for maybe an hour, then my neck started to stiffen up. By that evening I had a sharp ache at the base of my skull that spread into my shoulders. Turning my head to the left is the hardest part.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatories. I've also been doing some stretching at home.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we conclude?

A: Only that I'm still having headaches, and I've had to take a few days off work because sitting at a desk makes it worse. I just want to get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
